_about: Settings for the weekly build. Edit this file (not the script) when CMS changes fixed thresholds or you want to change which facilities are included.

exclude._about: Facilities in these counties are left out unless their city is in keep_cities. Default: drop the Las Vegas metro (Clark County) but keep Mesquite.

regions._about: County -> region label shown on the site. Any county not listed falls under 'default'.

staffing_ranges._source: CMS Five-Star Technical Users' Guide, Sept 2026, Table 3 (max 380 points)

qm_ranges._source: CMS Five-Star Technical Users' Guide, Sept 2026, Table 5 (effective July 2026 refresh). CMS may raise these again in January 2027.

health_cut_points_official._about: Nevada health inspection cut points from CMS's monthly State-Level Cut Point Table. Optional: when filled in, the site shows these instead of the estimate the script makes from the current data. Upper bound (inclusive) of each star band; 1 star is anything above the 2-star bound.
